scope: Existing YOLOE 2D instance masks -> measured depth points/voxels -> cross-frame association -> NSO assets; literature review only.

references.title: MaskFusion: Real-Time Recognition, Tracking and Reconstruction of Multiple Moving Objects
references.authors: Martin Rünz; Maud Buffier; Lourdes Agapito
references.verified_support: RGB-D SLAM uses image instance masks for labeled object-level reconstruction and tracking; establishes mask-to-object-map precedent.

references.title: PanopticFusion: Online Volumetric Semantic Mapping at the Level of Stuff and Things
references.authors: Gaku Narita; Takashi Seno; Tomoya Ishikawa; Yohsuke Kaji
references.verified_support: Integrates predicted 2D panoptic labels with measured depth in a spatially hashed volume; consults current 3D map to reconcile instance IDs varying between frames. Closest direct interface precedent.

references.title: ConceptFusion: Open-set multimodal 3D mapping
references.verified_support: Fuses pixel-aligned open-set foundation-model features into 3D maps using SLAM and multiview fusion; supports open-set mapping precedent, not a guarantee of persistent instance identity.

assessment.claim: Mask/depth projection, instance association and semantic 3D fusion are established perception/mapping routes, not a new NSO theory. The proposed adapter is not claimed to reproduce these complete systems.
assessment.unproven: These papers do not establish YOLOE accuracy in this room, this adapter association quality, NSO semantic benefit, unknown-space coverage efficiency or reconstruction accuracy.

boundaries_engineering_inferences_not_pa: Frame-local instance IDs require association; occlusion, mask split/merge and similar nearby instances can switch, duplicate or merge identities. Same class is not same physical instance.
Depth validity, intrinsics, extrinsics, synchronization and pose drift affect projected support and cross-frame matching; association can accumulate geometrically coherent errors.

Open-set labels and similarity/detection scores are predictions, not ground truth or calibrated probabilities. They do not establish object closedness or hidden internal structure; independent annotation is needed for accuracy claims.
Measured mask-supported voxels represent visible observed surfaces; they do not justify unobserved object completion or a true full-object extent.

Changing instance grouping/support can change NSO asset geometry, aperture, ordering/cap and resulting candidates or decisions even if native scoring code is unchanged. Declare and evaluate this sensor-input adaptation explicitly.
Evaluate perception/association, downstream decision effects, unknown coverage efficiency and reconstruction accuracy separately; unknown coverage remains primary.
verification: Titles, years, venues and stated support checked against author-submitted arXiv abstracts and official RSS abstract/BibTeX. DOI types are distinguished; no secondary-source claims used.
operations: No model training, code/policy/manuscript edits, experiments or robot/service operations.
